questions.question_text: How much time passes from $8{:}35$ am to $10{:}10$ am?

options.why: Subtracts minute values in the wrong direction and adds the difference to two hours.
Subtracts the displayed digits without regrouping 60 minutes as one hour.

questions.solution_text:
The times in 24-hour time are $08{:}35$ and $10{:}10$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $10^{\circ}10'-8^{\circ}35'=1^{\circ}35'$.
The elapsed time is $1\text{ h }35\text{ min}$.

questions.question_text:
A match starts at $14{:}25$ and lasts $1$ hour $50$ minutes.
When does it finish?

options.why: Adds hours and minutes but does not regroup 75 minutes as 1 hour 15 minutes.
Adds only 40 of the stated 50 minutes after advancing one hour.
Subtracts the duration from the start instead of adding it.

questions.solution_text:
Using the sexagesimal button, $14^{\circ}25'+1^{\circ}50'=16^{\circ}15'$.
The match finishes at $16{:}15$.

questions.question_text:
A lesson ends at $3{:}05$ pm and lasts $45$ minutes.
When did it start?

options.why: Borrows $100$ minutes instead of $60$ minutes from one hour, then calculates $105-45=60$ minutes.
Adds the duration to the finish time instead of subtracting it.
Subtracts only 35 minutes rather than the stated 45 minutes.

questions.solution_text:
$3{:}05\text{ pm}=15{:}05$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $15^{\circ}05'-0^{\circ}45'=14^{\circ}20'$.
The lesson started at $2{:}20\text{ pm}$.

questions.question_text: How long is it from $2318$ to $0042$ the next day?

options.why: Treats 0042 as an earlier same-day time and takes the absolute difference, ignoring the next-day instruction.
Compares only the minute parts and omits the hour across midnight.
Incorrectly uses $60+18=78$ minutes for each side of midnight, then calculates $78+78=156$ minutes, or $2$ hours $36$ minutes.

questions.solution_text:
The times are $23{:}18$ and $00{:}42$ in 24-hour time.
For the next-day finish, $0^{\circ}42'+24^{\circ}=24^{\circ}42'$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $24^{\circ}42'-23^{\circ}18'=1^{\circ}24'$.
The elapsed time is $1\text{ h }24\text{ min}$.

questions.question_text:
A flight arrives at $0520$ after $4$ hours $55$ minutes.
When did it leave?

options.why: Subtracts $4$ hours but subtracts only $5$ minutes instead of $55$ minutes, giving $01{:}20-0{:}05=01{:}15$.
Misreads the duration as $5$ hours $5$ minutes and adds it to the arrival time, giving $05{:}20+5\text{ h }5\text{ min}=10{:}25$.
Borrows $100$ minutes instead of $60$ minutes from one hour, then calculates $120-55=65$ minutes after subtracting the hours.

questions.solution_text:
The finish time is $05{:}20$ in 24-hour time.
Using the sexagesimal button, $5^{\circ}20'-4^{\circ}55'=0^{\circ}25'$.
The flight left at $0025$.

questions.question_text:
A timer starts at $22{:}46$ and runs for $3$ hours $37$ minutes.
When does it stop?

options.why: Adds the values but does not regroup 83 minutes as 1 hour 23 minutes.
Adds only 27 minutes instead of the stated 37 minutes.
Subtracts the duration from the start time instead of adding it.

questions.solution_text:
Using the sexagesimal button, $22^{\circ}46'+3^{\circ}37'=26^{\circ}23'$.
$26^{\circ}23'-24^{\circ}=2^{\circ}23'$.
The timer stops at $02{:}23$ the next day.

questions.question_text:
A film starts at 8:50 pm.
The film lasts 2 hours and 52 minutes.
What time does the film finish?

options.why: Adds $2$ hours and calculates $50+52=102$ minutes, but incorrectly carries $100$ minutes as one hour, leaving $2$ minutes and giving $11{:}02$ pm.
Adds $2$ hours, then adds $60-52=8$ minutes instead of $52$ minutes, giving $10{:}58$ pm.
Adds $2$ hours and calculates $50+52=102$ minutes, then subtracts $60$ from the minutes without adding the carried hour, giving $10{:}42$ pm.

questions.solution_text:
$8{:}50\text{ pm}=20{:}50$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $20^{\circ}50'+2^{\circ}52'=23^{\circ}42'$.
The film finishes at $11{:}42\text{ pm}$.

questions.question_text:
Jacob put a cake in the oven at 2:45 pm.
After 30 minutes he put some biscuits in the oven.
The cake and the biscuits were in the oven together for 45 minutes.
Then Jacob took them both out of the oven.
What time did Jacob take both the cake and the biscuits out of the oven?

options.why: Subtracts the first $30$ minutes from the $45$ minutes together, then adds only $45-30=15$ minutes to $2{:}45$ pm.
Treats the initial $30$ minutes as $45$ minutes, then adds $45+45=90$ minutes to $2{:}45$ pm, giving $4{:}15$ pm.
Adds the first $30$ minutes but subtracts the final $45$ minutes, giving $2{:}45\text{ pm}+30\text{ min}-45\text{ min}=2{:}30\text{ pm}$.

questions.solution_text:
$2{:}45\text{ pm}=14{:}45$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $14^{\circ}45'+0^{\circ}30'=15^{\circ}15'$.
The biscuits were added at $3{:}15\text{ pm}$.
$15^{\circ}15'+0^{\circ}45'=16^{\circ}00'$.
Jacob took both out at $4{:}00\text{ pm}$.

questions.question_text:
Isaac started eating his breakfast at 10:10 a.m.
He finished eating his breakfast 15 minutes later.
Which clock shows the time Isaac finished his breakfast?

options.text: A: An analogue clock with the short hand between 10 and 11 and the long hand pointing to 5, showing 10:25.
B: An analogue clock with the short hand pointing to 2 and the long hand pointing to 1, showing 2:05.
options.why: Shows a different hour and five minutes rather than the elapsed time.

options.text: C: An analogue clock with the short hand between 10 and 11 and the long hand pointing to 8, showing 10:40.
options.why: Uses forty minutes instead of adding fifteen minutes to 10:10.

options.text: D: An analogue clock with the short hand just past 10 and the long hand pointing to 3, showing 10:15.
options.why: Adds only five minutes to 10:10 instead of fifteen minutes.

questions.solution_text:
The start time in 24-hour time is $10{:}10$.
Using the sexagesimal button, $10^{\circ}10'+0^{\circ}15'=10^{\circ}25'$.
Select the clock showing $10{:}25$.
